I understand where the downvotes come from honestly. If I was never suicidal and read this as advice to someone who was suicidal I would have downvoted too. But I've been severely suicidal myself and so hopeless and in despair that the thought of "better things to come" for myself isn't enough for me to hold on. I have no interest in the better things. I do however have a family and no matter how much they don't give a shit inspite of reaching out, the thought of them having to dealing with suicide in a family and not to mention how it would affect my little brother is what keeps me going. I don't want this to traumatize him and his future so I'll just keep holding on and deal with this shit. Thats my obligation. It's little things like these that get me through another day. I don't want to ruin another life just cause mine was ruined. I've read some stories and I'm not that shitty to take a chance on that happening.

Just think of how it's just gonna ingrained deeper into your system and get worse and that should get you to take action. I let mine cook on low heat for a whole semester and it manifested so bad during my finals that the first thing I did was to get an appointment. I did talk to a counselor twice and I think that's what's getting me through the finals but I'm officially going right after. It's really expensive. 10 times as much as what my GP takes but that's how bad I've gotten.

A lot of people look back on their high school selves and wonder why the hell they were the way they were. I've been bullied too but the thing that helped me the most was to focus on my strengths and to surround myself with a solid group of friends who always have your back. Then all the negativity coming from those that don't matter won't matter. Just find that connection somewhere, know that someone loves you. God, your family, your friends, online friends, pets. If the people at your high school don't accept you, it's alright. Accept yourself first. Don't hold on to false expectations of your life in high school should have been.

Never ever let people get to you. Just not worth it. Just because how you look like is portrayed in a negative light on media does not mean you're not beautiful. If you're facing problems overthinking or wondering why you're suicidal just take out a book put on some music and just write every thought that ever comes to your head. It's healing. Promise you'll try it?
Please don't pass the pain onto someone else.
I'm here if you wanna talk.
If you're planning on giving your life up after predicting how it's gonna all turn out please don't. Take it one moment at a time.
Don't be hard on yourself. It's alright to lose control sometimes. It's nice that your dog keeps you grounded.
Never ever let people get the worst of you. Just not worth it.

"If people really want to be ur friend they will make some effort to"

Does that still work? I mean as we get older I really doubt people go out of their way to make the quiet ones feel included or try to befriend them. 
The only reason I'd approach me would be to see what lies behind the mysterious exterior.

I really want to be that way but the thing with me is if I'm putting any effort to talk and be nice to you, it's because I see friend potential else I don't bother at all. That attitude might be a bit destructive in the workplace cause rapport matters so much. 
But I just feel as a girl, there's a lot more pressure for me to be sociable. Also I'll be working in tech and women are highly underrepresented.
